id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

runtime.description: The runtime environment for the package.

resourcePath.description:
The ES package's path in the repository, relative to the C3 package resource folder.
If the package is part of a monorepo, this should be the path to the monorepo.
Leave empty if the package is in the root resource folder
See {@link Es#Package#workspaceName} to specify which package in the monorepo to use.

workspaceName.description:
The name of the package in the monorepo to use. Should match what is specified in
the package.json `workspaces` field. Will be used with `-w` on commands.

buildScript.description: The package build script name as defined in the package.json file.

setupScript.description: A package script name that's needed to run before running tests as defined in the package.json file.

cleanupScript.description: A package script name that's needed to run after running tests to clean up the environment as defined in the package.json file.

bundlerScript.description: The package bundle script name as defined in the package.json file.

testScript.description: The package test script name as defined in the package.json file.

coverageScript.description: The package test script name with coverage as defined in the package.json file.

testReportPaths.description: The path to the test report file inside the ES package.

coverageReports.description:
Configuration for running coverage tests, marking a failure if the coverage for
a certain file is not high enough.

title:
Represents an ECMA Script package.

Use this to define a package that can be built and bundled for testing purposes.
name: Es.Package
